planning_report.interpretation: Paired modeled balanced scores on jointly admitted trials. All admission differences include scheduled pairs. Descriptive 95% bootstrap intervals resample worlds after averaging paired seeds (5000 resamples, seed 6104). Uncorrected multiple comparisons; no hardware or universal superiority claim.

scope: 48 fresh primary worlds: 24 standard and 24 predeclared shifted geometry/terrain/friction worlds. Assisted walking simulation with gravity compensation; no real electrical or hardware validation.
